parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. <short pause> They are new every morning: <short pause> great is thy faithfulness. <short pause> Lamentations, chapter three, verses twenty-two and twenty-three.

Merciful God, Your compassion never runs dry. <short pause> Every morning I wake to fresh mercy, no matter what yesterday held. <short pause> Your faithfulness is great beyond measure. <short pause> Tonight I thank You for sustaining me, and I look forward to tomorrow's new grace. <short pause> Amen.
